note: `name EQU *+<const>` (and `*-<const>`) inside a relocatable PROC is a code LABEL — the current location plus a pure numeric addend — not an absolute equate. References must relocate (SEGNAME+offset) so a cross-object use gets the target object's placed base. _dir_equ previously special-cased only a bare `EQU *`; `EQU *+0` (StyleWriter patchprocs.a PuPiSrcLookupMask) fell through to the constant path, stayed object-local, and a small value emitted a DP operand with no reloc, so at link time the merged base was never added (0x397F / segment-base drift). A `* - label` DIFFERENCE still does NOT match (link-time constant, stays the equate path). Expected: `lda Lstar` is an absolute operand (AD ..) carrying a relocation, like `lda Lreal`, not a DP operand (A5 ..).
